title: hist2RNA : An Efficient Deep Learning Architecture to Predict Gene Expression from Breast Cancer Histopathology Images.
summary: Hist2RNA inferred breast-cancer gene-expression patterns from histopathology images, with held-out and external tissue-microarray evaluation. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
